description: The shared secret-name rule marks these members because their names contain `password`, `secret`, `token`, `credential` or `encryption key`, but each one is not a secret: it holds the name of a Secret Manager secret or version, a Cloud KMS key, a Credential resource, or a Cloud Storage URI of an encrypted file, so the secret itself is never in the field; or it is password metadata: an expiry time, a duration, a change interval, a status or the change-password URL. This removes the mark.
